subject.title: fix: doctor upgrade 7.2-beta.1 - 7.2-beta.2 fails on fractional restart handoffs

question: Should the repository accept pruning expired restart handoffs and truncating legacy fractional trace timestamps as the upgrade policy for the existing v2-to-v3 STRICT migration?
rationale: The patch changes persisted shared-state migration behavior; source and package proof support the implementation, but accepting the data-retention policy belongs to a human owner.

options.title: Accept and land after rebase
options.body: Rebase onto current `main`, refresh the exact package-upgrade proof, and merge if the preserved-live-row and expired-transient-row outcomes remain confirmed.

options.title: Require a different migration policy
options.body: Keep the PR open if maintainers want expired handoffs retained or fractional values handled by a different documented migration rule.

recommendation.title: Accept and land after rebase
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current `main`, refresh the exact package-upgrade proof, and merge if the preserved-live-row and expired-transient-row outcomes remain confirmed.
